# PART 13 — WORLD MAP & LOCATION RATTA 🌍

**UPPCS Priority: 🔴 VERY HIGH**

Pure **map-oriented ratta**.

Format:

> **Location → Country/Region → Geographical significance**

The aim is to be able to look at a blank world map and immediately recall **what lies where and why it matters**.

---

# 1. 🌊 IMPORTANT STRAITS — MASTER LIST

## 1. Strait of Gibraltar

> **Spain–Morocco → Mediterranean Sea ↔ Atlantic Ocean**

Significance:

> Gateway between Europe and Africa

> Entrance to Mediterranean from Atlantic.

---

## 2. Bosporus Strait

> **Turkey → Black Sea ↔ Sea of Marmara**

Significance:

> Separates European Turkey from Asian Turkey.

> Connects Black Sea with Mediterranean system.

### 🔥

> **Bosporus → Black Sea → Istanbul**

---

## 3. Dardanelles

> **Turkey → Aegean Sea ↔ Sea of Marmara**

Significance:

> Part of Turkish Straits system.

---

## 4. Turkish Straits

> **Bosporus + Sea of Marmara + Dardanelles → Turkey**

Connect:

> Black Sea ↔ Mediterranean.

### 🔥

> **Black Sea → Bosporus → Marmara → Dardanelles → Aegean → Mediterranean**

---

## 5. Strait of Hormuz

> **Iran–Oman → Persian Gulf ↔ Gulf of Oman**

Significance:

> Major global oil-export chokepoint.

### 🔥

> **Hormuz → Persian Gulf → Oil**

---

## 6. Bab-el-Mandeb

> **Yemen–Djibouti/Eritrea → Red Sea ↔ Gulf of Aden**

Significance:

> Gateway between Red Sea and Indian Ocean.

> Major maritime trade route.

### 🔥

> **Bab-el-Mandeb → Red Sea → Gulf of Aden**

---

## 7. Strait of Malacca

> **Malaysia–Indonesia → Andaman Sea ↔ South China Sea**

Significance:

> One of world's most important maritime trade routes.

> Connects Indian Ocean with Pacific maritime system.

### 🔥

> **Malacca → Malaysia + Indonesia → Indian Ocean–Pacific route**

---

> **Indonesia → Java Sea ↔ Indian Ocean**

Between:

> Java + Sumatra.

### 🔴

> **Sunda → Java–Sumatra**

---

> **Indonesia → Bali Sea ↔ Indian Ocean**

> Bali + Lombok.
